dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High prominence; sharp, thin pale boundaries are clearly visible on the edges of the folded primaries and secondaries against the darker brown centers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A dense, trapezoidal region of small, high-contrast dark speckles on a lighter brown background, located on the posterior neck.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A distinct horizontal boundary where the uniform solid brown of the crown transitions into the speckled texture of the nape and the scaled pattern of the mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced white scalloping across all dorsal coverts and scapulars, creating a repetitive U-shaped pattern.
